description: The output-padding branch prevents simultaneous input padding from copying into a correctly bounded destination.
trigger: Load an ordinary 130-by-130 weight with default pad_to=128.
expected_behavior: Copy into the leading 130-by-130 region of a zero-filled 256-by-256 matrix.
actual_behavior: The output-width condition selects padded[:130, :], a 130-by-256 destination, for the 130-by-130 source; the input-column branch is skipped.

finding.description: The inherited simultaneous-axis copy mismatch remains for explicitly opted-in Linear callers; the new default guard blocks it earlier for other callers.
